name: Ocean's Kyogre ex Constructed Starter Deck

releases.name: Ocean's Kyogre ex Constructed Starter Deck

description.text: A starter deck built around Kyogre ex, sold at Pokémon Centers from 3 March 2006 and in shops from 10 March, the same days as the Miracle Crystal expansion. Blastoise's evolution line and δ Delta Species Treecko and Grovyle back it up. It is a ready-built 30-card half deck with a coin, damage counters and markers, and a rule book.
